title: The discovery of a novel IkappaB kinase beta inhibitor based on pharmacophore modeling, virtual screening and biological evaluation.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IKKbeta小分子抑制剂发现，基于药效团建模和虚拟筛选，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background: IkappaB kinase beta (IKKbeta) plays a pivotal role in the NF-kappaB signaling pathway and is considered a promising therapeutic target for various diseases. Materials & methods: The authors developed and validated a 3D pharmacophore model of IKKbeta inhibitors via the HypoGen algorithm in Discovery Studio 2019, then performed virtual screening, molecular docking and kinase assays to identify hit compounds from the ChemDiv database. The compound with the highest inhibitory activity was further evaluated in adjuvant-induced arthritis rat models. Results: Among the four hit compounds, Hit 4 had the highest IKKbeta inhibitory activity (IC(50) = 30.4 +/- 3.8), and it could significantly ameliorate joint inflammation and damage in vivo. Conclusion: The identified compound, Hit 4, can be optimized as a therapeutic agent for inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：IkappaB激酶β（IKKbeta）在NF-kappaB信号通路中发挥关键作用，被认为是多种疾病的有前景的治疗靶点。材料与方法：作者通过Discovery Studio 2019中的HypoGen算法开发并验证了IKKbeta抑制剂的三维药效团模型，随后进行了虚拟筛选、分子对接和激酶测定，以从ChemDiv数据库中识别命中化合物。对抑制活性最高的化合物在佐剂诱导的关节炎大鼠模型中进行了进一步评估。结果：在四个命中化合物中，Hit 4具有最高的IKKbeta抑制活性（IC(50) = 30.4 ± 3.8），并且能显著改善体内的关节炎症和损伤。结论：所识别的化合物Hit 4可作为炎症性疾病的治疗剂进行优化。
